title: fix(metadata-protocol): the packaged app base carries contributed navigation, so Setup entries translate
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8oKsEJp8L8ojaxxRT7yAhQ)_

domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZMkHvuDeVYgTD73qF

Fixes #30504

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：服务端给翻译器的「打包基准」应用，现在带上了各插件往这个应用里贡献的菜单项（用的是读取时本来就在用的同一个合并函数）。中文控制台的设置侧栏 45 个子菜单从全英文变成按翻译目录显示中文；account 应用里贡献进去的「连接智能体」同样修好。
- 为什么改：这些子菜单都是插件贡献的，基准里没有它们，翻译器就把它们当成定制包自己写的菜单，跳过翻译目录，于是全显示英文，而目录里其实有译文（如 nav_users = 用户）。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个服务端读取函数，接口返回的结构不变，只是标签值变成译文；定制包（.custom）自己新写的菜单仍然只读定制包自己的译文（ADR-0146 D2 不变）。回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts` 的 `getPackagedAppBase`；`packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts` 末尾新增的 `[#30504]` 用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts -t 30504`，应看到 4 个用例通过；或用中文打开控制台的设置，侧栏子菜单显示「用户」「权限集分配」等中文。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`getPackagedAppBase(name)` (the body in `protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts`; `protocol.ts` and `meta-item-read-gate.ts` are untouched) now answers the app's packaged declaration with the code layer's navigation contributions folded in, through the one fold every served app read already applies, `SchemaRegistry.applyNavContributions` (ADR-0029 D7). No second copy of the fold. When the registry has no such method (a double) the declaration alone is answered, and a throw from the fold answers the declaration alone, which is the base `main` answered.

Why this is the fix: the served app is `declaration + contributions` (`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` folds them on read), while the base handed to `translateApp` was the declaration alone. For a node id the known base lacks, `packagedNavNodes` answers `{}`, `valueOverridesPackagedBase` reads the label as changed, and a changed label reads only the pair's translations (ADR-0146 D2). Outside a pair that bundle is empty, so every contributed entry kept its source text. With the contributions in the base, a contributed node is judged against its own packaged label and the catalog applies.

ADR-0146 D2 is preserved: a node a `.custom` override authors is in no contribution, so it is still absent from the base and still reads only the pair's translations, else its own text. Shape B (`packagedNavNodes` answering "no base knowledge" for an unknown id) was not taken, as the dispatch ruled: it would let the base catalog relabel an override-authored node.

## Tests

- New top-level describe `[#30504]` in `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts` (the #29613/#30062 real-boot harness that already pins the packaged app base), with and without a metadata service:
  - the packaged base carries the contributed entry, and the registry's own item is not mutated by the fold;
  - the base's own app, translated against that base, reads the contributed entry as `用户` in `zh-CN` and `Users` in `en`;
  - on the pair's declared override, the override-authored `nav_custom` keeps `Custom entry` with no pair translation (the catalog's `基包译文` is not taken) and reads the pair's `自定义入口` when the pair ships one, while the contributed `nav_users` reads `用户` in both.
- Red on `main`: the test committed first (`97886306`), `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` built without the fix: 4 failed / 87 skipped (`expected {} to deeply equal { nav_users: 'Users' }`). With the fix and a rebuild: the file 91/91 passed.
- After merging `origin/main` and rebuilding the objectql closure: this file plus `registry-nav-contribution-group-semantics.test.ts` and `registry-nav-contribution-disabled-package.test.ts`, 112/112 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run`: 316 files passed / 4 skipped, 22425 tests passed / 26 skipped (before the main merge; the merge brought only two metadata-protocol test files).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured whether other apps are hit the same way: every code-level contribution in the tree targets `setup`, plus one into `account` (`packages/mcp/src/connect-ui.ts`, `nav_connect_agent`), the same code path, fixed here (live: served `连接智能体`). Studio carries no code-level contributions, so it is not on this path.
- `protocol.ts`'s public docblock for `getPackagedAppBase` still reads "answered the same way" as the page base; it is left untouched to stay off seat 5's facade series, and the new behaviour is documented on the body in `protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts`. A one-line docblock follow-up there can ride a later `protocol.ts` PR.
- `nav_webhooks` reads `Webhooks` in zh-CN: that is the catalog's own zh-CN value, not a miss.

On `main` the ui seat's dev measured 0/45 (os-dev-report 6660644606).
- `Accept-Language: en`: 0/9 and 0/45 CJK, labels unchanged (`Users`, `Organization`, …).
